Naomi lost her husband and sons in a foreign land. How do you carry grief?
Orpah went back, but Ruth clung to Naomi. What does loyal love look like?
Ruth said, "Your people shall be my people, and your God my God." What does it mean to commit to God's people?
Naomi said, "Call me Mara... the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me." How can you be honest with God in your pain?
Ruth went to glean in the fields to provide for Naomi. How can you care for those close to you?
Boaz showed Ruth kindness beyond what she expected. Who has shown you unexpected kindness?
Boaz said Ruth had come to take refuge under God's wings. What does it mean to take refuge in God?
Naomi saw God's kindness in Boaz. Where can you see God's kindness in your life?
Naomi sought rest and security for Ruth. How can you seek the good of others?
Ruth asked Boaz to spread his wings over her. How does Boaz picture a redeemer?
Naomi said, "Wait... the man will not rest until he has settled the matter." What are you waiting on God for?
Boaz acted openly and honourably to redeem Ruth. How does Boaz point to Jesus, our Redeemer?
The women said, "Blessed be the Lord, who has not left you without a redeemer." How has God redeemed your story?
Obed became the grandfather of David. What does this show about God working through ordinary lives?
Ruth, a foreigner, is in the line of King David. What does this show about God's welcome?
